description.value: Choose a 30-foot cone, 10-foot emanation or 60-foot line. Creatures in the area take damage equal to your weapon damage dice plus one additional weapon damage die, with no other bonuses, penalties or modifiers, with a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC and spell DC. A creature that critically fails also takes your critical specialization effect and extra deadly or fatal damage as if you had critically hit.
